At 6.11.2^{commit} b501abd1f0f2acf49c39f2d9cd47b460578d87f0, pkg/api/http/server.go registers /echo, /echo/*, /api/echo, and /api/echo/* onto echoHandler. With BackendURL empty, pkg/api/http/echo.go reads the request body and in the else branch sets only X-Color before w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted) and w.Write(body), with no Content-Type or X-Content-Type-Options. Go net/http MIME-sniffs an HTML-leading body as text/html, so a cross-origin auto-submitted POST can execute reflected script in the podinfo origin. Finder write-up and GHSA match this source-to-sink.
